tld.purpose: Used by Multicast DNS (mDNS) to allow devices to find each other on local networks
tld.remarks:
The .local domain is used for Multicast DNS (mDNS), allowing devices to find each other on local networks without needing a central DNS server. Commonly used by services like Bonjour/ZeroConf, it helps discover devices like printer.local or speaker.local connected to your local network.

For further information, see [Multicast DNS](https://www.iana.org/go/rfc6762) (RFC 6762).
